annotation.title_en: Launch of the National Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Governance and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital, Malaysia (Deputy Prime Minister's speech)
annotation.summary_en: Speech text from the launch of Malaysia's National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE) in September 2024. It stresses AI's economic benefits, says AI ethics codes are essential for trust, and notes the guidelines complement existing cyber and data laws, the new National AI Office, and ASEAN alignment. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: AIGE guidelines reinforce existing laws such as the Cyber Security Act 2024 and the amended PDPA 2010
National AI Office (NAIO) under MyDIGITAL Corporation to start operating in November 2024
Ministry to propose a Malaysia Data Commission and table a Data Sharing Bill
AIGE aligns with ASEAN AI governance and ethics guidance, with Malaysia as 2025 ASEAN Chair
'AI Untuk Rakyat' self-learning programme to raise AI literacy
